<size=40><color=Title>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color></size>
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, and Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state for {0}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Maestro</color></size>
Gain {5} ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color> in turn. Each <color=Highlight>Volatile Note</color> holds for {1}s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Basic Attack</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Dodge</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Reset</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Curtain Call</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> and end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to {4} times in total during Phrolova's <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}.
Switching back to Phrolova ends <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
Ending <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Hecate</color></size>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and Stagnating the targets (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Curtain Call</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, casting <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.

<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume two <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Based on the types of the <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color> and <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>.
- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Trust</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>.
- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color>.
When consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if Sigrika holds at least <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> by {2}. Obtain a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=141203>Innate Gift?</te></color>.
When consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> is lower than <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3}, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>. Every <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> consumed grants the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> {5} DMG Amplification.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color> deals Echo Skill DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Runic Outburst</color></size>
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Runic Chain Whip</color></size>
Stagnate nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Runic Soliskin</color></size>
Pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> reaches <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6}, if <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> is not on Cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Resonance Skill</color> to consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Innate Gift?</color></size>
Sigrika can hold up to <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=7} of <color=Highlight>Innate Gift?</color>. Each stack grants <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> and <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> {8} DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> or is switched off the field.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Rune</color></size>
Sigrika holds up to <color=Highlight><SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=9}</color>. Without <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can only hold up to <color=Highlight><SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=A}</color>. When Sigrika gains a new <color=Highlight>Rune</color> at max capacity, the existing <color=Highlight>Runes</color> shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost <color=Highlight>Rune</color>. With at least <SapTag=B>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can hold <SapTag=C>{12}</SapTag> additional {Cus:Sap,S=Rune P=Runes SapTag=C}.
Hitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color>.
Hitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Full Stop</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, gain <SapTag=D>{13}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color>, up to 100 points.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Soliskin Vitality</color></size>
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains <SapTag=E>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight>Soliskin Vitality</color>, up to <SapTag=F>{15}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F}. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - In This Very Moment</color> resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Thực hiện tối đa 2 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> để thi triển <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Rending Lunge</color></size>
Gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này trên mặt đất để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này giữa không trung để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Death Snip</color></size>
Mở kéo, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Sau một lúc, kéo sẽ cắt xuống, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> và hồi HP cho tất cả Resonators trong đội ở gần.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong khi thi triển kỹ năng này để gây thêm <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Nhấn <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> lần nữa để cắt mục tiêu ngay lập tức.
Sát thương của kỹ năng được tính là <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color> để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thread Withdrawn</color></size>
Gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Có thể kích hoạt Dodge thành công trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi thi triển.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Nhảy lên không và tiêu hao STA để tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Không thể thi triển kỹ năng này khi đang ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
Thực hiện các hành động sau trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>;
- Thi triển <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> và {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trước khi tiếp đất.
Giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trước khi tiếp đất sau khi thi triển <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Tiêu hao STA để thực hiện Đòn Lao Xuống, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Khi không ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi thi triển Mid-air Attack Trung để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color></size>
Gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi thi triển <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.
Nếu bị gián đoạn, có thể thi triển lại <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> bằng cách giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trước khi tiếp đất. Hiệu ứng này chỉ có thể kích hoạt một lần trước khi tiếp đất.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hanging Finality</color></size>
Tiêu hao STA để thực hiện Đòn Lao Xuống, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này trên mặt đất để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> thành công để tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color></size>
Giữ <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> sau khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> thành công trên mặt đất để thi triển <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>, tấn công và gây Trì Hoãn mục tiêu, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- Khi không ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trên mặt đất hoặc sử dụng <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> giữa không trung để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. Hiệu ứng này sẽ bị loại bỏ khi Chisa vào <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
- Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thi triển kỹ năng này để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Rending Lunge</color></size>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Death Snip</color></size>
Open the scissors, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during this skill to deal additional <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thread Withdrawn</color></size>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
This skill cannot be cast while in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>;
- Cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color></size>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.
If interrupted, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> can be cast again by holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hanging Finality</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color></size>
Hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color> to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground or use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. This effect is removed when Chisa enters <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color></size>
Giảm HP xuống còn 50% HP tối đa, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> biến hình thành <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, mở khóa các động tác mới và bước vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> trong 12 giây.
Có thể thực hiện khi đang ở trên không.
Vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> sẽ xóa toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
Dưới dạng <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> và <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> ngay lập tức gây 1 lần DMG <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> và giảm 1 tầng <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> trên mục tiêu trúng đòn.
- Kết thúc trạng thái sẽ không làm mất Resonance Energy.
- Không tiêu hao HP khi HP dưới 50%.

Các đòn tấn công của <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> phục hồi <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> khi trúng đích. Khi <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> đạt 120 điểm, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation để tung <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

Khi <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> dưới 120 điểm, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation để biến hình trở lại thành <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> dưới dạng Cartethyia không tiêu hao Resonance Energy.

Khi <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> có <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> sẽ tạo ra một trường lực để Stagnate các mục tiêu trong phạm vi.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> tăng khả năng kháng gián đoạn.
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> sẽ bị loại bỏ khi trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> kết thúc.

Khi <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> có <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
DMG <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> được Amplify thêm 50% và khoảng thời gian gây sát thương giảm 50% đối với kẻ địch trong một khoảng cách nhất định từ <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> sẽ bị loại bỏ khi trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> kết thúc.

Khi <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> có <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
Khi tung <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> và <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> hoặc sau khi <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> gây DMG, tăng tầng <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> của tất cả mục tiêu gần đó lên số tầng cao nhất trong số các mục tiêu.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> sẽ bị loại bỏ khi trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> kết thúc.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> sẽ biến hình trở lại thành <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> trong <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color> hoặc khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Công cụ</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> có thể đi bộ trên mặt nước. Khi di chuyển trên vùng nước sâu sẽ liên tục tiêu hao STA. Khi ở trạng thái đi bộ, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> có thể bước ra khỏi vị trí cao và đi bộ trên không trung bằng cách liên tục tiêu hao STA.

<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color></size>
Dưới dạng <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, khi <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> dưới 120 điểm, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> và tạm thời biến hình trở lại thành <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, đồng thời tạm dừng đồng hồ đếm thời gian của trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Có thể sử dụng khi đang ở trên không. Sử dụng kỹ năng trên không sẽ thực hiện <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Fleurdelys</color></size>
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, sử dụng Resonance Liberation dưới dạng <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> sẽ thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> mà không tiêu hao Resonance Energy và biến hình trở lại thành <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, đồng thời tiếp tục đếm thời gian của trạng thái <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color></size>
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, unlocking new moves and entering the <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases. 
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>: 
<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color></size>
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, when <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> and temporarily transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, which pauses the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Fleurdelys</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting Resonance Liberation as <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> performs <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, which resumes the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color></size>
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, ends <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
Lunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. By default, Iuno enters the <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>.
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. 
- Iuno's movement becomes <color=Highlight>Meandering</color>, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight><te href=141003>Sentience</te></color> on hit.
She can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, or <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.
Casting Absolute Fullness ends <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon</color> domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Full Moon Domain</color></size>
Resonators inside the domain periodically restore  HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

<size=40><color=Title>Blessing of the Wan Light</color></size>
The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>
Iuno can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color> restores 25 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit.

Khi Thanh Lion's Spirit đầy, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike</color></size>
Khi Thanh Lion's Spirit chưa đầy, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> ngay sau <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Striding Lion</color></size>
Sau khi tung chiêu Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, Lingyang sẽ bước vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color>.
Sau khi sử dụng Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color> hoặc Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, nếu Thanh Lion's Spirit đầy, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> để bước vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color>.
Trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color>:
- Có thể tấn công giữa không trung. Nếu Lingyang đang ở trên mặt đất, sử dụng Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> để quay lại không trung.
- Thanh Lion's Spirit sẽ liên tục bị tiêu hao, và khi cạn kiệt, trạng thái <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> sẽ kết thúc.
- Tốc độ tiêu hao Lion's Spirit trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color> sẽ giảm.
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> của Lingyang sẽ được thay thế bằng Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Feral Gyrate</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> của Lingyang sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Mountain Roamer</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
- Khi Lion's Spirit còn dưới {3}, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> để thực hiện Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Sau khi thực hiện Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> sẽ khả dụng.
- Tiêu hao Lion's Spirit sẽ hồi phục Concerto Energy.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lion's Spirit</color></size>
Lingyang có thể chứa tối đa {4} Lion's Spirit.
Lingyang nhận được Lion's Spirit thông qua <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> và <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge</color></size>
When Lion's Spirit is full, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike</color></size>
When Lion's Spirit is not full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Striding Lion</color></size>
After casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.
After casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, if Lion's Spirit is full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.
In the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state:
- Attacks can be performed in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> to get back in the air.
- Lion's Spirit is continuously consumed, and when it runs out, the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state ends.
- The consumption rate of Lion's Spirit in the <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color> state is reduced.
- Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Feral Gyrate</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
- Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mountain Roamer</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
- When Lion's Spirit is less than {3}, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. After performing Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, the Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> becomes available.
- Consuming Lion's Spirit restores Concerto Energy.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lion's Spirit</color></size>
Lingyang can hold up to {4} Lion's Spirit.
Lingyang gains Lion's Spirit through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion</color></size>
Carlotta activates <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> every {0}s.
When Substance is full and <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> is activated, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color>, after which <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> enters cooldown. 
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG), and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color> by {1}s.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Final Bow</color></size>
When Substance is full, enter the <color=Highlight>Final Bow</color> state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Era of New Wave</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color> by {14}. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> or when <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Substance</color></size>
Carlotta can hold up to {2} points of Substance.
Cannot gain Substance while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore {3} points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.
Restore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>.
Restore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>.
Consume {4} Moldable Crystal and restore {12} points of Substance upon casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Moldable Crystal</color></size>
Carlotta can hold up to {6} Moldable Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystal while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore {7} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Restore {11} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
Restore {8} Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>.
Restore {13} Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.
Restore {9} Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color>.
Restore {10} Moldable Crystals upon a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.

translation:
<size=40><color=Title>Wildfire Banner</color></size>
Attack của Lupa tăng {0} trong {1} giây khi thực hiện các hành động sau:
- Sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>.
- Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, hoặc <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.
- Sử dụng Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>.
- Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> và <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf</color></size>
Khi <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> đạt {2} điểm, Resonance Skill sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color>. Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> sẽ tiêu hao toàn bộ <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Liberation).
Có thể thực hiện khi đang ở gần mặt đất giữa không trung.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color></size>
Khi <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> đạt {3} điểm trong trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color>, Resonance Skill sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> sẽ tiêu hao toàn bộ <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Liberation). <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> sẽ biến mất khi kỹ năng kết thúc.
Có thể thực hiện khi đang ở gần mặt đất giữa không trung.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze</color></size>
Trong vòng {4} giây sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>, Lupa sẽ tiếp tục hiện diện trên chiến trường sau khi chuyển đổi Resonator và hỗ trợ Resonator đang hoạt động khi họ sử dụng <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Skill). Hiệu ứng này chỉ có thể kích hoạt một lần trong thời gian tồn tại.

<size=40><color=Title>Wolflame</color></size>
Lupa có thể giữ tối đa {5} điểm Lửa Sói.
- Khôi phục Lửa Sói khi Normal Attack trúng mục tiêu.
- Khôi phục Lửa Sói khi sử dụng Resonance Skill.
- Khôi phục Lửa Sói khi sử dụng Resonance Liberation.

<size=40><color=Title>Wolfaith</color></size>
Lupa có thể giữ tối đa {6} điểm Niềm Tin Sói.
Niềm Tin Sói tồn tại trong {7} giây. Thời gian sẽ được đặt lại khi Niềm Tin Sói được khôi phục. Khi hết thời gian, mỗi điểm Niềm Tin Sói còn lại sẽ chuyển thành {8} điểm Lửa Sói.
- Khôi phục {9} điểm Niềm Tin Sói khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, hoặc <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.
source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Wildfire Banner</color></size>
Lupa's ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s when performing the following actions:
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> and <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf</color></size>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {2} points, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color></size>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {3} points in the <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color> state, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> is removed when the skill ends.

translation:
["Tower Trial"]
Trong Tower Trial, kỹ năng của bạn sẽ được thử lửa. Hoàn thành các mục tiêu thử thách cụ thể để nhận được Huy Hiệu. Khi đủ Huy Hiệu, bạn sẽ nhận được những phần thưởng hậu hĩnh.

[Zone và Tower]
<color=#c19f51>The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, Hazard Zone, and Overdrive Zone.</color> Mỗi Zone có từ một đến ba Tower, mỗi Tower lại có nhiều Tầng, mỗi Tầng là một thử thách độc đáo. Vượt qua các thử thách để mở khóa Tower và Zone mới. Hoàn thành Zone Ổn định sẽ mở khóa Zone Thí nghiệm, và hoàn thành Zone Thí nghiệm sẽ đồng thời mở khóa Hazard Zone và Zone Quá tải.

[Sinh lực]
Trong Tower Trial, mỗi lần hoàn thành thử thách sẽ làm giảm một lượng Sinh lực nhất định của Resonators tham gia. Khi Sinh lực của một Resonators cạn kiệt, họ không thể tham gia thử thách mới nữa. <color=#c19f51>Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Đặt lại] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.</color>

[Hiệu ứng Zone]
Trong Tower Trial, các hiệu ứng môi trường đặc biệt sẽ ảnh hưởng đến chiến thuật chiến đấu của bạn.

[Giai đoạn Trial]
Rewards Huy Hiệu ở Zone Ổn định, Zone Thí nghiệm và Zone Quá tải chỉ có thể nhận một lần. <color=#c19f51>However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are periodically reset, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and claim fresh rewards.</color>

[Đồng bộ Kỷ lục]
Kỷ lục thử thách của bạn ở <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-2 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> từ Giai đoạn Trial trước sẽ được giữ lại nếu bạn đã kiếm được <color=#c19f51>24</color> Huy Hiệu trong Giai đoạn Trial trước với <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> ở các Tầng này;
Kỷ lục thử thách của bạn ở <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-3 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> từ Giai đoạn Trial trước sẽ được giữ lại nếu bạn đã kiếm được <color=#c19f51>30</color> Huy Hiệu trong Giai đoạn Trial trước với <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> ở các Tầng này.
source_en:
[Tower of Adversity]
In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. With enough Crests, you shall collect hefty rewards.

[Zone and Tower]
<color=#c19f51>The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, Hazard Zone, and Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers, and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing Stable Zone will unlock Experiment Zone, and clearing Experiment Zone will unlock Hazard Zone and Overdrive Zone at the same time.

[Vigor]
In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' Vigor by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can no longer take part in new challenges. <color=#c19f51>Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.</color>

[Area Effects]
In the Tower of Adversity, special environmental effects will influence your combat tactics.

[Trial Phase]
Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can only be claimed once. <color=#c19f51>However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are periodically reset, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and claim fresh rewards.</color>

[Record Sync]

<size=40><color=Title>Incarnation</color></size>
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>:
- Skill Basic Attack thay thế <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Basic Attack"</color> sẽ khả dụng. Thực hiện tối đa 4 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Skill. Chu kỳ Basic Attack sẽ không bị reset. Có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
- Resonance Skill thay thế <color=Highlight>"Crescent Divinity"</color> sẽ khả dụng. Gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
- Skill Heavy Attack thay thế <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color> sẽ khả dụng. Tấn công mục tiêu trên không với chi phí Stamina, gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Skill Dodge thay thế <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge"</color> khả dụng khi đang bay. Có thể sử dụng nhiều lần với chi phí Stamina.
- Skill Phản Đòn thay thế <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge Counter"</color> sẽ khả dụng. Gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany</color></size>
Sau Stage 4 của <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> sẽ kết thúc và Jinhsi nhận được <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color>.
Có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
Khi <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color> còn hiệu lực:
- Basic Attack được thay thế bằng Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color>. Tấn công mục tiêu trên không với chi phí Stamina, gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Resonance Skill được thay thế bằng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>"Illuminous Epiphany"</color>. Phóng <color=Highlight>Solar Flare</color> kích nổ thành <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>, gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> sau một khoảng thời gian ngắn. Tiêu hao tối đa {0} Tia Lửa, mỗi điểm Tia Lửa tăng thêm phần trăm Hệ Số Sát Thương cho <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>.
Có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
- Sau khi sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color>, Jinhsi nhận được <color=Highlight>Unison</color>. Hiệu ứng này có thể kích hoạt mỗi {1} giây một lần.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>

<size=10></size>

Hiệu ứng này có thể được kích hoạt bởi Đòn Phối Hợp của cùng một Thuộc Tính tối đa {8} lần mỗi {7} giây.

<size=40><color=Title>Incarnation</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>:
- Alternative Basic Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Basic Attack"</color> becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>"Crescent Divinity"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color> becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Alternative Dodge <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge"</color> is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.
- Alternative Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge Counter"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany</color></size>
After Stage 4 of <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> terminates and Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color>. 
Can be cast in mid-air.
While <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color> lasts:
- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color>. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>"Illuminous Epiphany"</color>. Send out <color=Highlight>Solar Flare</color> that detonates as <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> after a short delay. Consume up to {0} Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
- After casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color>, Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Unison</color>. This can be triggered once every {1}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>
While Jinhsi has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. <color=Highlight>Unison</color> will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Incandescence</color></size>
Jinhsi can hold up to {2} Incandescence.
When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain <color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color>.
<color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color> provides 2 independent effects:
Jinhsi gains {3} Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to {5} time(s) every {4}s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains {6} Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to {8} time(s) every {7}s.

translation:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Thực hiện tối đa 4 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack giai đoạn 4 gây 1 tầng <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> lên mục tiêu trúng đòn.
- Khi ba giai đoạn đầu của Basic Attack của Ciaccona bị gián đoạn do Dodge, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Basic Attack kịp thời để tiếp tục chu kỳ tấn công và thực hiện giai đoạn Basic Attack tương ứng.
- Sau Basic Attack giai đoạn 4, Ciaccona bắt đầu <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. Nếu Basic Attack giai đoạn 4 hoặc <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> của Ciaccona kết thúc sớm (chủ động hoặc bị gián đoạn), một <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> sẽ được tạo ra.

<size=40><color=Title>Solo Concert</color></size>
Khi Ciaccona hoặc Ensemble Sylph thực hiện Solo Concert, họ sẽ tăng 24% Aero DMG Bonus cho tất cả Resonators gần đó trong đội. Hiệu ứng này không thể cộng dồn.

<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>
Tối đa 2 Ensemble Sylph có thể tồn tại đồng thời.
Nếu <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> của Ciaccona bị gián đoạn, các Ensemble Sylph được tạo ra sẽ hoàn thành đòn tấn công thay Ciaccona và bước vào <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.
Nếu <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> của Ciaccona bị gián đoạn, các <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> được tạo ra sẽ tiếp tục <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> thay Ciaccona.
Ngoài hai tình huống trên, Ensemble Sylph được tạo ra bởi <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> sẽ hoàn thành đòn tấn công hiện tại của Ciaccona mà không bước vào <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Tiêu hao STA để nhảy lên không trung và tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Aim để vào chế độ Aiming và bắn phát đạn đã tích năng, gây <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, được tính là DMG của Heavy Attack.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Tiêu hao STA để thực hiện tối đa 2 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack sau giai đoạn 2 của Mid-air Attack để thực hiện Basic Attack giai đoạn 4.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
Thực hiện <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> sau khi <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> thành công để tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title> Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> is generated.

<size=40><color=Title>Solo Concert</color></size>
When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>
Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> is interrupted, the <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> generated will continue the <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
Follow up successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

Để chấm dứt cuộc khủng hoảng này, những Tacet Discord được rèn từ dữ liệu này phải bị tiêu diệt.
source_en:
Fallacy of No Return now uses data to summon Tacet Discords!
 
<color=Highlight>Lampylumen Myriad</color>: Fallacy of No Return summons a Lampylumen Myriad the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>95%</color> and gains a 
<color=Highlight>Shield equal to 80% of its own Max HP</color>. Defeating Lampylumen Myriad <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Lampylumen Myriad's Glacio RES is reduced.

<color=Highlight>Shield equal to 80% of its own Max HP</color>. Defeating Inferno Rider <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Inferno Rider's Fusion RES is reduced.

Defeating Impermanence Heron <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Impermanence Heron's Havoc RES is reduced.

The error codes in the Stellar Matrices have compromised the Tethys System's defenses during the data breach. Using Fallacy of No Return as the framework, they've spawned Overlord-Class Tacet Discords for self-protection. To end this crisis, these data-forged Tacet Discords must be destroyed.

<size=40><color=Title>Yin-Yang Balance</color></size>

<size=10></size>

- Âm Khí Nhỏ đạt được sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>.
source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Yin-Yang Balance</color></size>
When Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the <color=Highlight>Yin-Yang Balance</color> state, replacing her <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell</color> with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony</color></size>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and generating a <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> at the target area. When the array is active, all Resonators in the team enter the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state.
- While in <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color>, when any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> grants <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to the active Resonator in the team. When any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> during this state, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color> grants additional <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to the active Resonator in the team.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Minor Yang and Minor Yin</color></size>
- Minor Yang is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain</color>.
- Minor Yin is obtained after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>.

<size=10></size>

<size=10></size>

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>

<size=10></size>

<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Blossom Mode</color></size>
- Không thể di chuyển khi bị treo trên dây leo.
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> và Kỹ Năng Nặng <color=Highlight>Pruning</color> được thay thế bằng Kỹ Năng Basic <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>: thực hiện liên tiếp 4 đòn tấn công, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, được tính là Sát Thương Kỹ Năng Basic.
- Khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 3</color>, giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> để tung ra <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color>, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> trước khi tự động thực hiện <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 4</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> được thay thế bằng Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>. Nhấn <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> ngay sau khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> thành công để tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, được tính là Sát Thương Kỹ Năng Basic.
- Resonance Skill được thay thế bằng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>. Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, được tính là Sát Thương Kỹ Năng Basic.
- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> có thể sử dụng khi đang bay.
- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> kết thúc sau khi sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> kết thúc sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Levitator</color>.
- Nhảy được thay thế bằng Kỹ Năng Basic <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>. Sử dụng Nhảy để tấn công mục tiêu với chi phí STA, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (được tính là Sát Thương Kỹ Năng Basic). Điều này sẽ kết thúc <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.
- Sử dụng Kỹ Năng Basic <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color> và Kỹ Năng Basic <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> khi đang bay sẽ tiêu hao STA.
- Sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> không hồi phục STA.
- Tiêu hao STA liên tục để duy trì trạng thái treo trên dây leo.
source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Crimson Blossom</color></size>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG), then enter <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.
This attack can be performed in mid-air.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Blossom Mode</color></size>
- Unable to move while suspended on vines.
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Pruning</color> are replaced by Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color>: chain together 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- When performing <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> that deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> before automatically performing <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz Stage 4</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced by Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Atonement</color>. Tap <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> can be cast in mid-air.
- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color> ends after using the <color=Highlight>Levitator</color>.
- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Ronde</color>. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG). This ends the <color=Highlight>Blossom Mode</color>.
- Using Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Vining Waltz</color> and Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Blazing Waltz</color> in mid-air consumes STA.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Floral Ravage</color> doesn't restore STA.
- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.

translation:
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> kéo dài trong {11} giây.
- Khi bước vào <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye tạo ra một <color=Highlight>Trường Resonance</color>.
- Trong <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye nhận được <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
- Nếu <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> dưới {0} khi giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 đến 3</color> theo thứ tự. - Khi di chuyển, Mornye liên tục tiêu hao STA. STA không thể hồi phục trong <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- Khi Dodge có nhập hướng, Mornye sẽ bay với tốc độ cao, hiệu ứng kéo dài tối đa 10 giây hoặc cho đến khi STA cạn kiệt hoặc <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> kết thúc.
- Khi Mornye bị tấn công hoặc bị hất tung lên không trung, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge để hồi phục ngay lập tức, được tính là Dodge thành công. Hiệu ứng này có thể kích hoạt tối đa {12} lần và sẽ được đặt lại khi <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> kết thúc.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} nhảy và Mornye sẽ từ từ hạ xuống. Trước khi cô ấy tiếp đất, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> và <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> sẽ không khả dụng. Nếu nhảy khi STA của Mornye cạn kiệt, cô ấy sẽ thoát khỏi <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. Cô ấy cũng sẽ rời khỏi chế độ này khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>, nhảy hoặc thực hiện đòn tấn công giữa không trung.
Ngoài ra, thực hiện tương tác với môi trường, sử dụng vật phẩm tiện ích hoặc chuyển đổi sang Resonator khác sẽ kết thúc <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. Trạng thái này cũng kết thúc khi Mornye không còn ở trên không.
source_en:
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.
- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
- If <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- When Dodging with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

translation:

<color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> tiếp theo được sử dụng trong vòng {2} giây sau khi dùng kỹ năng này sẽ không tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>

Enhance hiệu ứng của Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color> sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>.
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> và <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> đạt giới hạn, sẽ kích hoạt <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>. <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> sẽ bị loại bỏ khi trạng thái <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> kết thúc.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> để thi triển <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> khi đáp ứng đủ các điều kiện sau:
- Đang ở trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color>.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> đạt giới hạn.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> đạt giới hạn.

Switch về dạng Aemeath sau khi sử dụng kỹ năng này.

source_en:
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color></size>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Switch into Mech form after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Casting this skill grants the following effects:
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> for {0}s.
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> for {1}s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Stardust Resonance</color></size>
Enhance the effect of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>.
This effect ends after <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is cast {3} times.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>.

- <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.

Switch back to Aemeath after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Chain Resonance Skill</color> và <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> sẽ tích lũy <color=Highlight>Wolflame</color>.

Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> không tiêu hao Resonance Energy.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>

- Giữ <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> để vào trạng thái nạp. Trong trạng thái này, tiêu hao 1 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> theo chu kỳ. Sử dụng kỹ năng sẽ tiêu hao 300 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> và <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, đồng thời kết thúc trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>.
